name: video-prompt-reverse
title_zh: 逐镜头拆解视频，输出带证据帧的中英双文提示词包
tagline_zh: 拿到一段成片，反推它每一镜怎么生成：画面证据帧、镜头语言、中英提示词全配齐。不靠猜，不靠感觉。
tagline_en: Feed it any video, get back shot-by-shot generation specs: evidence frames, camera language, and bilingual.
desc_en: Reverse-engineer a supplied video into a shot-by-shot generation specification, displayed evidence frames, and paired Chinese-English prompt packages. Use for requests such as 视频反推提示词, 视频转提示词, 从视频生成提示词, 视频逆向提示词, 逐镜头反推, 分镜拆解并生成提示词, 反推视频 prompt, or video-to-prompt; also use for Veo, Sora, Kling, Wan, generic prompt adaptation, and bounded generate-compare-optimize loops. Do not use for ordinary vide
why_zh: 不是笼统描述画面，而是把镜头拆到可执行粒度——每镜配证据帧和双语提示词。
why_en: It doesn't summarize—it decomposes to executable granularity, pairing each shot with visual evidence and bilingual prompts.
limit_zh: 只处理视频输入，不接纯文本描述；输出到提示词包为止，不负责实际生成视频；依赖本地 ffmpeg 抽帧。
limit_en: Video input only—no text-to-prompt. Output stops at prompt packages, not generated video. Requires local ffmpeg; long videos slow without GPU.
title_en: Reverse video into shot-by-shot prompts with evidence frames
